admission.justification: A torn store read as empty would drop a notice the developer has not seen and reclaim the acknowledgement behind it, which is a silent loss of exactly the fact the feature exists to report. The three-state observation and the quarantine cases pin the distinction.

applicability: Terminal-notice observation and the acknowledgements it protects.
conditions: A missing store, a readable store that holds nothing and uninterpretable bytes are three distinct observations.
Uninterpretable bytes are quarantined beside the store and never read as an empty one.
An incomplete observation neither clears a visible occurrence nor reclaims its acknowledgement.
exclusions: Rewriting or deleting unreadable bytes in place.
Treating a failed read as proof that no notice exists.
Reclaiming an acknowledgement while its occurrence may still be published.

evidence: notes/reports/reviewer/267804e5-dd71-51e8-8f1d-d975effaaeaf/role-launch/round4/L190-fix-verification-R4.json#L190-R1-F07; Prior sealed closure retained; not reopened in fixed-list R4.

statement: Incomplete notice observations do not clear visible occurrences or prematurely reclaim their acknowledgements.
